/**

 * of the blocks, `<slot />`) gets a count and a note of what the drop does: a copy, a new

  const parent = props.to?.parentKey == null ? undefined : editor.get(String(props.to.parentKey));
  if (!parent) return verb; // a plain move at the page's top level needs no words
  const name = parent.text.trim() || KINDS[parent.kind].name;

});

import { computed, inject, onMounted, useTemplateRef } from 'vue';
import { useDnD } from '@vue-dnd-kit/core';
import { KINDS, KIND_LIST, type Block, type BlockKind } from './blocks';
import { EDITOR } from './editor';

/** The menu of a handle: for the selected blocks, or the clicked one. Turn into, duplicate, delete. */
const emit = defineEmits<{ close: [] }>();
const editor = inject(EDITOR)!;
const { selection } = useDnD();

const ids = computed(() => [...selection.ids].map(String));
const blocks = computed(() => ids.value.map(editor.get).filter((block): block is Block => !!block));
const TURNS = KIND_LIST.filter((kind) => !KINDS[kind].fixed);
const turnable = computed(() => blocks.value.some((block) => !KINDS[block.kind].fixed));
const current = computed(() => (new Set(blocks.value.map((block) => block.kind)).size === 1 ? blocks.value[0]!.kind : null));
const heading = computed(() => (blocks.value.length > 1 ? `${blocks.value.length} blocks` : KINDS[blocks.value[0]?.kind ?? 'text'].name));

const isMac = typeof navigator !== 'undefined' && /Mac|iPhone|iPad/.test(navigator.userAgent);

const turn = (kind: BlockKind) => {
  editor.turnInto(ids.value, kind);
  emit('close');
};

const duplicate = () => {
  const copies = editor.duplicate(ids.value);
  selection.set(copies);
  emit('close');
  editor.focusHandle(copies[0]!);
};

const remove = () => {
  editor.remove(ids.value);
  selection.clear();
  emit('close');
};

// A menu: the arrows go through its items, Escape closes it and gives the focus back.
const menu = useTemplateRef<HTMLElement>('menu');
const items = () => [...(menu.value?.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>('[role^="menuitem"]') ?? [])];
onMounted(() => (items().find((item) => item.getAttribute('aria-checked') === 'true') ?? items()[0])?.focus());

const STEPS: Record<string, number> = { ArrowDown: 1, ArrowRight: 1, ArrowUp: -1, ArrowLeft: -1 };
const onKeydown = (event: KeyboardEvent) => {
  event.stopPropagation(); // the page's shortcuts (Delete, arrows) stay out of the menu
  const all = items();
  const step = STEPS[event.key];
  if (step) {
    event.preventDefault();
    const at = all.indexOf(document.activeElement as HTMLElement);
    all[(at + step + all.length) % all.length]?.focus();
  } else if (event.key === 'Escape') {
    event.preventDefault();
    emit('close');
    editor.focusHandle(ids.value[0]!);
  }
};
</script>

import { computed, inject, useTemplateRef } from 'vue';
import { makeSortableItem, type FlatNode } from '@vue-dnd-kit/core';

import { EDITOR } from './editor';

const props = defineProps<{ node: FlatNode<Block>; indent: number; number: number }>();
/** A click on the handle: the page decides what it selects. */

const editor = inject(EDITOR)!;

const el = useTemplateRef<HTMLElement>('el');
// Only the handle drags, so the text stays editable and selectable. The handle takes the
// keyboard too: Space picks the block up, the arrows move the line (left and right: a level
// out or in), Space drops it.
const { indicator, selected } = makeSortableItem(el, {
  id: () => props.node.key,
  handle: '.handle',
  // A mouse press on a handle drags at once; after 4px instead, a click opens the block's
  // menu without picking the block up first. So does Enter.
  activation: { mouse: { distance: 4 } },
  canDrag: (event) => !('key' in event && event.key === 'Enter'),
});

// The line starts where the text starts at the level the drop lands at.
const line = computed(() => {
  const at = indicator.value;
  if (!at || at.side === 'inside') return null;
  return { side: at.side, left: `${((at.depth ?? 0) - props.node.depth) * props.indent}px` };
});
</script>

/** The caret in a plain-text field (`contenteditable="plaintext-only"`), counted in characters. */

export type Caret = 'start' | 'end' | number;

/** Where the caret is in the field's text; `null` when it isn't there, or text is selected. */
export const caretOffset = (field: HTMLElement): number | null => {
  const selection = getSelection();
  if (!selection?.rangeCount || !selection.isCollapsed) return null;
  const caret = selection.getRangeAt(0);
  if (!field.contains(caret.startContainer)) return null;
  const before = document.createRange();
  before.selectNodeContents(field);
  before.setEnd(caret.startContainer, caret.startOffset);
  return before.toString().length;
};

/** Focuses the field with the caret at its start, its end or an offset of its text. */
export const placeCaret = (field: HTMLElement, at: Caret) => {
  field.focus({ preventScroll: true });
  field.scrollIntoView({ block: 'nearest' });
  const length = field.textContent?.length ?? 0;
  let rest = at === 'start' ? 0 : at === 'end' ? length : Math.min(at, length);
  const range = document.createRange();
  range.selectNodeContents(field);
  range.collapse(false); // the end, unless a text node holds the offset
  const texts = document.createTreeWalker(field, NodeFilter.SHOW_TEXT);
  for (let node = texts.nextNode(); node; node = texts.nextNode()) {
    const size = node.textContent!.length;
    if (rest <= size) {
      range.setStart(node, rest);
      range.collapse(true);
      break;
    }
    rest -= size;
  }
  getSelection()?.removeAllRanges();
  getSelection()?.addRange(range);
};

/**
 * Whether the caret is on the field's first line (`-1`) or last line (`1`): the arrow keys
 * go on to the next field from there, and move between lines inside it otherwise.
 */
export const caretOnEdgeLine = (field: HTMLElement, side: 1 | -1): boolean => {
  const selection = getSelection();
  const caret = selection?.rangeCount ? selection.getRangeAt(0).getClientRects()[0] : undefined;
  if (!caret) return true; // an empty field: one line
  const box = field.getBoundingClientRect();
  const line = parseFloat(getComputedStyle(field).lineHeight) || caret.height;
  return side === -1 ? caret.top - box.top < line * 0.75 : box.bottom - caret.bottom < line * 0.75;
};

import { computed, nextTick, ref, shallowRef, type InjectionKey } from 'vue';
import { KINDS, copyBlock, createBlock, createPage, locate, snapshot, type Block, type BlockKind, type Place } from './blocks';
import { placeCaret, type Caret } from './caret';

/** The deepest level a block can sit at: the page is 0. */
export const MAX_DEPTH = 3;

/** The menu that is open: the block menu of a handle, or the menu of new blocks ("+" or "/"). */
export type Menu =
  | { type: 'block'; id: string }
  | { type: 'insert'; id: string }
  /** "/" typed in a block, at `at`: what follows it filters the menu. */
  | { type: 'command'; id: string; at: number };

interface State {
  title: string;
  blocks: Block[];
}

/** How many levels a block's subtree goes down below it. */
const height = (block: Block): number => Math.max(0, ...block.children.map((child) => height(child) + 1));

/** Gives a block another kind. A kind that takes no nested blocks hands them over: they follow it, a level up. */
const setKind = ({ siblings, index }: Place, kind: BlockKind) => {
  const block = siblings[index]!;
  block.kind = kind;
  if (kind === 'todo') block.done ??= false;
  if (!KINDS[kind].nests) siblings.splice(index + 1, 0, ...block.children.splice(0));
};

/**
 * The document and everything that changes it, provided to every component of the demo:
 * the tree, the text fields, the menus and the top bar. Each edit records the state
 * before it, so Undo takes back drops, typing and menu actions alike.
 */
export function createEditor() {
  const title = ref('Launch plan');
  const blocks = ref<Block[]>(createPage());
  /** Toggles that are closed: the tree hides their blocks. */
  const collapsed = ref(new Set<string>());
  const menu = shallowRef<Menu | null>(null);
  /** The editor's element: fields and handles are found in it by their block's id. */
  const root = shallowRef<HTMLElement | null>(null);

  const find = (id: string) => locate(blocks.value, id);
  const get = (id: string) => {
    const place = find(id);
    return place ? place.siblings[place.index] : undefined;
  };

  // ─── Status: a line in the top bar, read by screen readers ───────────────────

  const message = ref('');
  let quiet: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined;
  const say = (text: string) => {
    message.value = text;
    clearTimeout(quiet);
    quiet = setTimeout(() => (message.value = ''), 2600);
  };

  // ─── History ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  const past = shallowRef<State[]>([]);
  const future = shallowRef<State[]>([]);
  /** The block being typed in: its keystrokes make one step, until something else happens. */
  let typing: string | null = null;

  const capture = (): State => ({ title: title.value, blocks: snapshot(blocks.value) });

  /** Called before every change: the state it changes goes on the undo stack. */
  const record = () => {
    past.value = [...past.value.slice(-99), capture()];
    future.value = [];
    typing = null;
  };

  const recordTyping = (id: string) => {
    if (typing === id) return;
    record();
    typing = id;
  };

  const travel = (from: typeof past, to: typeof past, done: string) => {
    const state = from.value.at(-1);
    if (!state) return;
    from.value = from.value.slice(0, -1);
    to.value = [...to.value, capture()];
    title.value = state.title;
    blocks.value = state.blocks;
    typing = null;
    say(done);
    // The focused block may be gone: the focus stays in the editor, on the title.
    nextTick(() => {
      if (!root.value?.contains(document.activeElement)) focus('title');
    });
  };

  const undo = () => travel(past, future, 'Undone');
  const redo = () => travel(future, past, 'Redone');

  // ─── Focus ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  const all = (selector: string) => [...(root.value?.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>(selector) ?? [])];

  /** Puts the caret in a block's text, once the change that made the block has rendered. */
  const focus = async (id: string, at: Caret = 'end') => {
    await nextTick();
    const field = root.value?.querySelector<HTMLElement>(`[data-text="${id}"]`);
    if (!field) return focusHandle(id); // a divider: no text
    placeCaret(field, at);
    field.scrollIntoView({ block: 'nearest' });
  };

  const focusHandle = async (id: string) => {
    await nextTick();
    root.value?.querySelector<HTMLElement>(`[data-handle="${id}"]`)?.focus();
  };

  /** The arrow keys at the edge of a field: on to the field above or below (the title too). */
  const focusNext = (field: HTMLElement, step: 1 | -1, at: Caret) => {
    const fields = all('[data-text]');
    const next = fields[fields.indexOf(field) + step];
    if (!next) return;
    placeCaret(next, at);
    next.scrollIntoView({ block: 'nearest' });
  };

  /** The ids of the blocks on screen, in reading order (none from closed toggles). */
  const visibleIds = () => all('[data-handle]').map((handle) => handle.dataset.handle!);

  // ─── Edits ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  /** Adds a block below another one, or at the end of the page, with the caret in it. */
  const insertAfter = (id: string | null, block: Block) => {
    record();
    const place = id ? find(id) : null;
    if (place) place.siblings.splice(place.index + 1, 0, block);
    else blocks.value.push(block);
    focus(block.id, 'start');
  };

  /** Adds a block into another one, first: an empty toggle's "add a block". */
  const insertInto = (id: string, block: Block) => {
    record();
    get(id)!.children.unshift(block);
    focus(block.id, 'start');
  };

  /** Enter: the text after the caret goes into a new block below, and the caret with it. */
  const split = (id: string, offset: number) => {
    const { siblings, index, parent } = find(id)!;
    const block = siblings[index]!;
    const info = KINDS[block.kind];
    // Enter in an empty list item ends the list: it steps out a level, or becomes text.
    if (info.continues && !block.text) {
      if (parent) return outdent(id);
      return turnInto([id], 'text');
    }
    record();
    const next = createBlock(info.continues ? block.kind : 'text', block.text.slice(offset));
    block.text = block.text.slice(0, offset);
    // Right below the line, where it shows: above the block's own children when they are in sight.
    if (block.children.length && !collapsed.value.has(id)) block.children.unshift(next);
    else siblings.splice(index + 1, 0, next);
    focus(next.id, 'start');
  };

  /** Backspace at the start of a block: it becomes text first, then joins the text above. */
  const backspace = (id: string) => {
    const block = get(id)!;
    if (block.kind !== 'text') return turnInto([id], 'text');
    const ids = visibleIds();
    const above = get(ids[ids.indexOf(id) - 1] ?? '');
    if (!above) return;
    // A divider or an image above gets the focus, and the next Backspace deletes it.
    if (KINDS[above.kind].fixed) return focusHandle(above.id);
    record();
    const join = above.text.length;
    above.text += block.text;
    // The blocks nested in it stay on screen where they were: they take its place.
    const { siblings, index } = find(id)!;
    siblings.splice(index, 1, ...block.children);
    focus(above.id, join);
  };

  /** Removes blocks with what is nested in them; the focus goes to the block above, or the title. */
  const remove = (ids: string[]) => {
    const visible = visibleIds();
    record();
    for (const id of ids) {
      const place = find(id); // gone already when it was nested in another removed block
      place?.siblings.splice(place.index, 1);
    }
    const first = visible.findIndex((id) => ids.includes(id));
    const next = [...visible.slice(0, first).reverse(), ...visible.slice(first)].find((id) => get(id));
    if (next) focusHandle(next);
    else focus('title');
    say(ids.length === 1 ? 'Block deleted' : `${ids.length} blocks deleted`);
  };

  /** The given blocks that aren't nested in another given block, in reading order. */
  const outermost = (ids: ReadonlySet<string>, list = blocks.value): Block[] =>
    list.flatMap((block) => (ids.has(block.id) ? [block] : outermost(ids, block.children)));

  /** Copies blocks with what is nested in them. Neighbours are copied as a run, after its last block. */
  const duplicate = (ids: string[]): string[] => {
    record();
    const runs: { siblings: Block[]; last: number; copies: Block[] }[] = [];
    for (const block of outermost(new Set(ids))) {
      const { siblings, index } = find(block.id)!;
      const run = runs.at(-1);
      if (run?.siblings === siblings && run.last === index - 1) {
        run.copies.push(copyBlock(block));
        run.last = index;
      } else runs.push({ siblings, last: index, copies: [copyBlock(block)] });
    }
    // From the last run up: inserting there leaves the indices of the runs above as they are.
    for (const run of [...runs].reverse()) run.siblings.splice(run.last + 1, 0, ...run.copies);
    const copies = runs.flatMap((run) => run.copies.map((copy) => copy.id));
    say(copies.length === 1 ? 'Block duplicated' : `${copies.length} blocks duplicated`);
    return copies;
  };

  const turnInto = (ids: string[], kind: BlockKind) => {
    record();
    for (const id of ids) {
      const place = find(id)!;

  };

   * A pick in the "/" menu: the command typed after the slash goes. An empty block becomes
   * the kind picked (a divider leaves a new line below it); one with text gets it below.
   */
  const command = (id: string, from: number, to: number, kind: BlockKind) => {
    record();
    const place = find(id)!;
    const block = place.siblings[place.index]!;
    block.text = block.text.slice(0, from) + block.text.slice(to);
    if (block.text) {
      const next = createBlock(kind);
      place.siblings.splice(place.index + 1, 0, next);
      return focus(next.id, 'start');
    }
    setKind(place, kind);
    if (kind !== 'divider') return focus(id, 'start');
    const line = createBlock('text');
    place.siblings.splice(place.index + 1, 0, line);
    focus(line.id);
  };

  /** Tab: the block goes into the one above it, at the end. */
  const indent = (id: string) => {
    const { siblings, index, depth } = find(id)!;
    const block = siblings[index]!;
    const above = siblings[index - 1];
    if (!above || !KINDS[above.kind].nests || depth + 1 + height(block) > MAX_DEPTH) return;
    record();
    siblings.splice(index, 1);
    above.children.push(block);
    collapsed.value.delete(above.id); // a closed toggle opens to show it
    focus(id, 'end');
  };

  /** Shift+Tab: the block steps out of its parent. The blocks below it come along, nested in it, so nothing moves on screen. */
  const outdent = (id: string) => {
    const { siblings, index, parent } = find(id)!;
    if (!parent) return;
    record();
    const [block, ...below] = siblings.splice(index);
    if (KINDS[block!.kind].nests) block!.children.push(...below);
    else siblings.push(...below);
    const outer = find(parent.id)!;
    outer.siblings.splice(outer.index + 1, 0, block!);
    focus(id, 'end');
  };

  const check = (id: string) => {
    record();
    const block = get(id)!;
    block.done = !block.done;
  };

  const toggle = (id: string) => {
    if (collapsed.value.has(id)) collapsed.value.delete(id);
    else collapsed.value.add(id);
  };

  return {
    title,
    blocks,
    collapsed,
    menu,
    root,
    message,
    get,
    record,
    recordTyping,
    undo,
    redo,
    canUndo: computed(() => past.value.length > 0),
    canRedo: computed(() => future.value.length > 0),
    focus,
    focusHandle,
    focusNext,
    visibleIds,
    insertAfter,
    insertInto,
    split,
    backspace,
    remove,
    duplicate,
    turnInto,
    command,
    indent,
    outdent,
    check,
    toggle,
  };
}

const matches = computed(() =>
  KIND_LIST.filter((kind) => {
    const { name, hint, markdown } = KINDS[kind];
    const q = query.value;
    const words = `${name} ${hint}`.toLowerCase().split(/[\s-]+/);
    return !q || markdown === q || name.toLowerCase().startsWith(q) || words.some((word) => word.startsWith(q));

};

      if (!editor.collapsed.value.has(block.id)) visit(block.children);

});

  if (!field || !scroller) return;
  const top = field.getBoundingClientRect().top - scroller.getBoundingClientRect().top + scroller.scrollTop - 24;
  const smooth = !matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;

import { computed, inject, nextTick, onBeforeUnmount, onMounted, ref, useTemplateRef, watch } from 'vue';
import { makeSelectionArea, makeSortableTree, useDnD, useDnDMonitor, type Key } from '@vue-dnd-kit/core';
import BlockGhost from './BlockGhost.vue';
import BlockMenu from './BlockMenu.vue';
import BlockRow from './BlockRow.vue';
import Editable from './Editable.vue';
import InsertMenu from './InsertMenu.vue';
import { KINDS, copyBlock, createBlock, type BlockKind } from './blocks';
import { caretOnEdgeLine } from './caret';
import { EDITOR, MAX_DEPTH } from './editor';

const editor = inject(EDITOR)!;
const { menu } = editor;
const { selection } = useDnD();

const INDENT = 24;
const scroller = useTemplateRef<HTMLElement>('scroller');
const sheet = useTemplateRef<HTMLElement>('sheet');
const root = useTemplateRef<HTMLElement>('root');

// The page is a tree: the blocks nested in a block are its children, one level in.
// `placeholder: 'indicator'`: nothing moves while you drag, a line shows where the blocks
// go and at which level. Dragging sideways changes the level (`nesting: 'offset'`), as far
// as the block above takes nested blocks. The whole sheet takes drops, below the last block too.
const { items } = makeSortableTree(root, {
  id: 'page',
  items: editor.blocks,
  group: 'blocks',
  placeholder: 'indicator',
  nesting: 'offset',
  indentation: INDENT,
  maxDepth: MAX_DEPTH,
  canNest: (_block, parent) => !!KINDS[parent.kind].nests,
  collapsed: editor.collapsed,
  // Alt-drag copies a block, with what is nested in it.
  clone: copyBlock,
  // A kind dragged from the menu or the sidebar becomes a new block, where the line is.
  createItem: (active) => createBlock((active.data as { kind: BlockKind }).kind),
  // Changes no drag made (Enter, Tab, Delete, Undo) slide and fade too.
  animateChanges: true,
  overOverlay: BlockGhost,
  dropzone: sheet,
  onDrop: (event) => {
    editor.record(); // the library writes the drop after this: Undo takes it back
    // A new block takes the caret. A moved one keeps the focus on its handle, so the
    // shortcuts (Undo, Delete) go on working: moving its row in the page would drop it.
    const first = event.items[0]!.id;
    if (event.mode === 'insert') editor.focus(first, 'start');
    else editor.focusHandle(first);
  },
});

// A numbered item counts the numbered items right above it, at its level.
const numbers = computed(() => {
  const numbers = new Map<Key, number>();
  const previous = new Map<Key | null, Key>(); // the last block seen under each parent
  for (const { key, item, parentKey } of items.value) {
    const before = previous.get(parentKey);
    if (item.kind === 'numbered') numbers.set(key, (before === undefined ? 0 : (numbers.get(before) ?? 0)) + 1);
    previous.set(parentKey, key);
  }
  return numbers;
});

// A box drawn from the margins selects the blocks it touches, and a click there clears the
// selection (`'select'`). It picks blocks only, not the options of the menu.
const { isSelecting, style } = makeSelectionArea(scroller, {
  strategy: 'select',
  accept: 'blocks',
  disabled: () => menu.value !== null, // a press closes the menu first
});

// A handle's click selects its block and opens its menu; Shift-click selects every block
// from the last clicked one, Ctrl/Cmd-click adds or removes one. Selected blocks drag together.
let anchor: string | null = null;
const pick = (id: string, event: MouseEvent) => {
  const ids = editor.visibleIds();
  if (event.shiftKey && anchor && ids.includes(anchor)) {
    const [from, to] = [ids.indexOf(anchor), ids.indexOf(id)].sort((a, b) => a - b);
    return selection.set(ids.slice(from, to! + 1));
  }
  anchor = id;
  if (event.ctrlKey || event.metaKey) return selection.toggle(id);
  if (!selection.has(id)) selection.set([id]);
  menu.value = { type: 'block', id };
};

const addAtEnd = () => {
  const last = editor.blocks.value.at(-1);
  if (last?.kind === 'text' && !last.text && !last.children.length) return editor.focus(last.id);
  editor.insertAfter(null, createBlock('text'));
};

const onTitleKeydown = (event: KeyboardEvent) => {
  const first = editor.blocks.value[0];
  if (event.key === 'Enter') {
    event.preventDefault();
    if (first) editor.focus(first.id, 'start');
    else addAtEnd();
  } else if (event.key === 'ArrowDown' && caretOnEdgeLine(event.currentTarget as HTMLElement, 1)) {
    event.preventDefault();
    editor.focusNext(event.currentTarget as HTMLElement, 1, 'start');
  }
};

// ─── Menus ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

/** "/" menu: what was typed after the slash; `null` once the slash is gone. */
const typed = computed(() => {
  const open = menu.value;
  if (open?.type !== 'command') return undefined;
  const text = editor.get(open.id)?.text ?? '';
  return text[open.at] === '/' ? text.slice(open.at + 1) : null;
});
watch(typed, (value) => {
  if (value === null || value?.includes('\n')) menu.value = null;
});

const pickKind = (kind: BlockKind) => {
  const open = menu.value!;
  const command = `/${typed.value ?? ''}`;
  menu.value = null;
  if (open.type === 'command') editor.command(open.id, open.at, open.at + command.length, kind);
  else editor.insertAfter(open.id, createBlock(kind));
};

const closeInsert = () => {
  const open = menu.value;
  menu.value = null;
  if (open?.type === 'insert') editor.focus(open.id);
};

// Opened below the block ("+", "/") or its handle, and kept inside the sheet.
const popover = useTemplateRef<HTMLElement>('popover');
const place = ref<{ top: number; left: number } | null>(null);
watch(menu, async (open) => {
  place.value = null;
  if (!open) return;
  await nextTick();
  const row = sheet.value?.querySelector<HTMLElement>(`[data-row="${open.id}"]`);
  if (!row || !sheet.value) return (menu.value = null);
  const below = (open.type === 'block' ? row.querySelector('.handle')! : row).getBoundingClientRect();
  const box = sheet.value.getBoundingClientRect();
  place.value = { top: below.bottom - box.top + 6, left: below.left - box.left };
  await nextTick();
  if (!popover.value) return;
  place.value.left = Math.max(8, Math.min(place.value.left, box.width - popover.value.offsetWidth - 8));
  popover.value.scrollIntoView({ block: 'nearest' });
});

// In the "/" menu the caret stays in the block: the menu takes the keys it uses first.
const insertMenu = useTemplateRef<InstanceType<typeof InsertMenu>>('insertMenu');
const onKeydownCapture = (event: KeyboardEvent) => {
  if (menu.value?.type === 'command' && insertMenu.value?.key(event)) event.stopPropagation();
};

// A press anywhere else closes the menu.
const onPressOutside = (event: PointerEvent) => {
  if (menu.value && !popover.value?.contains(event.target as Node)) menu.value = null;
};
onMounted(() => window.addEventListener('pointerdown', onPressOutside, true));
onBeforeUnmount(() => window.removeEventListener('pointerdown', onPressOutside, true));

// A block dragged out of the menu of new blocks: the menu hides while it travels, so the
// page shows where it goes, and closes once it has landed.
const lifted = ref(false);
useDnDMonitor({
  onDragStart: ({ active }) => (lifted.value = !!popover.value?.contains(active.element)),
  onDragSettle: () => {
    if (!lifted.value) return;
    lifted.value = false;
    menu.value = null;
  },
});
</script>

    <div ref="sheet" class="sheet">
      <div class="emoji" aria-hidden="true">🚀</div>

        v-model="editor.title.value"
        tag="h1"

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, inject, onMounted, useTemplateRef } from 'vue';
import { useDnD } from '@vue-dnd-kit/core';
import InsertOption from './InsertOption.vue';
import Outline from './Outline.vue';
import Page from './Page.vue';
import { KIND_LIST, createBlock, type Block } from './blocks';
import { EDITOR } from './editor';

/** The editor's window: a top bar, the page, and two sidebars when there is room for them. */
const editor = inject(EDITOR)!;
const { selection, status } = useDnD();

const el = useTemplateRef<HTMLElement>('el');
onMounted(() => (editor.root.value = el.value));

const words = computed(() => {
  const count = (blocks: Block[]): number =>
    blocks.reduce((sum, block) => sum + (block.text.match(/\S+/g)?.length ?? 0) + count(block.children), 0);
  return count(editor.blocks.value);
});
const meta = computed(() =>
  selection.ids.size ? `${selection.ids.size} selected` : `${words.value} ${words.value === 1 ? 'word' : 'words'}`,
);

const isMac = typeof navigator !== 'undefined' && /Mac|iPhone|iPad/.test(navigator.userAgent);
const shortcut = (keys: string) => (isMac ? keys.replace('Ctrl+', '⌘') : keys);

// The editor's shortcuts. A keyboard drag owns the keys while it runs.
const onKeydown = (event: KeyboardEvent) => {
  if (status.value === 'dragging' || event.defaultPrevented) return;
  const target = event.target as HTMLElement;
  const command = event.ctrlKey || event.metaKey;
  const key = event.key.toLowerCase();
  const chosen = [...selection.ids].map(String);
  const handle = target.dataset.handle; // a focused handle: its block
  const field = target.dataset.text; // a focused text: its block, or the title

  if (command && (key === 'z' || key === 'y')) {
    event.preventDefault();
    if (key === 'y' || event.shiftKey) editor.redo();
    else editor.undo();
    if (field) editor.focus(field);
  } else if (command && key === 'd') {
    // Duplicates the selected blocks, or the one being typed in.
    const ids = chosen.length ? chosen : [field ?? handle].filter((id) => id && id !== 'title') as string[];
    if (!ids.length) return;
    event.preventDefault();
    const copies = editor.duplicate(ids);
    if (chosen.length) selection.set(copies);
    if (chosen.length || handle) editor.focusHandle(copies[0]!);
  } else if (target.isContentEditable || target.matches('input')) {
    // Typing: the other keys are the text's.
  } else if ((key === 'delete' || key === 'backspace') && (chosen.length || handle)) {
    event.preventDefault();
    editor.remove(chosen.length ? chosen : [handle!]);
    selection.clear();
  } else if (key === 'escape' && chosen.length) {
    event.preventDefault();
    selection.clear();
  } else if (handle && (key === 'arrowup' || key === 'arrowdown')) {
    // From handle to handle, selecting as it goes (Shift: adding).
    event.preventDefault();
    const ids = editor.visibleIds();
    const next = ids[ids.indexOf(handle) + (key === 'arrowdown' ? 1 : -1)];
    if (!next) return;
    if (event.shiftKey) selection.add(handle, next);
    else selection.set([next]);
    editor.focusHandle(next);
  } else if (handle && command && key === 'a') {
    event.preventDefault();
    selection.set(editor.visibleIds());
  }
};
</script>
